records.title: Before I Enter a Persuasive Feed
records.promise: Recover a purpose and a chosen stance before entering a place designed to keep pulling.
records.primary_moment: Before a user-selected social, news, shopping, or entertainment destination.
records.trigger_posture: Destination-linked invitation where supported; manual shortcut otherwise.
records.toolkit_suggestions: Power first; purpose first; shorter route; protected-domain answer prominence; trigger-only scope.
records.privacy_default: No destination-use or visit-length log. Trigger label stored only as configured.
records.source_file: Now Starter Systems Content Pack and Canonical Routing Matrix - v0.2.xlsx

records.title: When Something Feels Off
records.promise: Find a usable orientation after an unclear, overwhelming, pressured, or boundary-crossing moment without having to explain it.
records.primary_moment: Manual entry during a pause or shortly after a moment that remains unsettled.
records.trigger_posture: Manual by default; optional user-scheduled transition invitation.
records.practice_link: PRACTICE:S1 or PRACTICE:S2 according to selected focus
records.toolkit_suggestions: Facts first; power first; no body route; shorter completion.
records.privacy_default: Run is ephemeral. Nothing is stored unless you choose to keep it.
records.source_file: Now Starter Systems Content Pack and Canonical Routing Matrix - v0.2.xlsx

records.title: When I Cannot Tell What I Want
records.promise: Let uncertainty become a legitimate position and find a next step that does not require clarity.
records.primary_moment: Any overloaded, mixed, low-access, or undecidable moment.
records.trigger_posture: Manual or selectable as the fallback route from any starter.
records.toolkit_suggestions: Facts route; single words; no body prompts; one fewer question; uncertainty answer prominence.
records.privacy_default: Nothing to infer or retain from inability to answer. Run remains ephemeral by default.
records.source_file: Now Starter Systems Content Pack and Canonical Routing Matrix - v0.2.xlsx
